services.name: Christine W. Private Charters
services.desc: Enjoy a fun time with your group! Duration & Rates 3 Hour Private Charter: $2,100 Additional Time: $700/hr About If you’re seeking a boat ride that conjures the feeling of floating down the Mississippi River and reading Mark Twain, then come aboard Christine W. She is an authentic stern wheeler and the perfect place to host gatherings, complete with guaranteed views of the Seattle skyline from its spacious decks. Christine W is one of the few paddle-wheel driven vessels on the West Coast and she has been offering cruises in the Seattle area since 2003 when the owner, Jack, bought the boat. services.name: Lake Union/ Picnic Cruise (private & semi-private)
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing cruise around Lake Union! Duration From 1 hour About Upgrade your adventure with a private picnic cruise on Lake Union. Great for both couples and small groups as well as larger groups up to 14ppl. Pack a picnic and join us on our 26ft boat with unobstructed views of downtown and the Space Needle. Spend an hour cruising by Gas Works Park, past the floating homes, and enjoy a relaxing cruise around Lake Union. Bring your own light snacks and drinks for lunch and happy hour charters, team building, picnics on the water, and special events. Need more time on the water? Upgrade to our 2-hour private cruise. services.name: 2 Hour Intro to Sailing
services.desc: Learn the basics of sailing! Duration 2 hours About Curious about sailing? Not sure if sailing is the activity for you? Our Introduction to Sailing will help you answer these questions and more. It’s a great way to learn the ropes…literally! Our lessons are hands-on and on small, exciting performance boats. Learn to tack, jibe, and steer the boat. We’ll cover all the basics to help you become familiar with sailing and answer all of your questions.
